decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management offer, and industry turnover is growing, so performance likely meets aspirations and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
The cleaning centrifuge complements the firm's filtration systems and supports its sustainability positioning, and a large firm's slack lets it carry the product while results mature.
Coolant nozzles are a low-cost line that adds to established systems, so dropping it releases few resources and has little justification.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's conveyor business for metalworking customers and are likely performing at or above aspiration.
The magnetic belt conveyor fills a standard niche in the modular conveyor portfolio, with no signal of a shortfall that would prompt search for other uses of resources.
Hinged belt conveyors are a core, widely demanded product type close to the established offer, so keeping them is consistent with satisficing behaviour.
